request: Treat a backslash before a wildcard as an ordinary path character rather than a quoting instruction, so our imported filename rules can use that character without special handling.

source.request: Treat a backslash before a wildcard as an ordinary path character rather than a quoting instruction, so our imported filename rules can use that character without special handling.
source.settled: A backslash before ?, *, or [ removes that character's special meaning in glob patterns.
source.why: Treating the prefix as an ordinary character prevents the wildcard escaping implemented by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
